urn:epoch:document-adapter:parsed-docume.title: ParsedDocument
urn:epoch:document-adapter:parsed-docume.description: Normalized typed view of a parsed mapping-table document: descriptor, canonical bytes, mapping rows.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:record-versio.title: DocumentRecordVersion
urn:epoch:document-adapter:record-versio.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized document-adapter document (currently 1).

urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-desc.title: DocumentDescriptor
urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-desc.description: Content-addressed (SHA-256 over canonical bytes), format-typed, tenant-scoped document descriptor.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-scope.title: TenantScope
urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-scope.description: Tenant scoping: owning tenant plus optional workspace/project narrowing.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-id.title: TenantId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:tenant-id.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:workspace-id.title: WorkspaceId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:workspace-id.description: Opaque workspace identity: "workspace:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:project-id.title: ProjectId
urn:epoch:document-adapter:project-id.description: Opaque project identity: "project:" followed by a lowercase slug.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-form.title: DocumentFormat
urn:epoch:document-adapter:document-form.description: Deterministic document form: structured-text or structured-json (real formats are future adapters).

urn:epoch:document-adapter:parsed-mappin.title: ParsedMappingRow
urn:epoch:document-adapter:parsed-mappin.description: One parsed mapping row: source path, W002 semantic target, property mappings, optional confidence/capability reference.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:source-path.title: SourcePath
urn:epoch:document-adapter:source-path.description: Stable identifier of a document field inside a typed document form.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:semantic-type.title: SemanticTypeKey
urn:epoch:document-adapter:semantic-type.description: W002 world-model semantic namespace type key (namespace:name); the core namespace is reserved for kernel vocabulary.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-mapp.title: PropertyMapping
urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-mapp.description: One property-level mapping from a document property onto a semantic property.

urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-name.title: PropertyName
urn:epoch:document-adapter:property-name.description: Document property name (source and semantic sides), W002 property-name grammar.

QualifiedTypeReference.title: QualifiedTypeReference
QualifiedTypeReference.description: Reference to a versioned, protocol-defined type: dot-namespaced id plus semver core version.
